newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Four Russian aircraft-makers to pool efforts.
newsitem.headline: Four Russian aircraft-makers to pool efforts.

text.p: Russian aviation manufacturers have signed an agreement to work together on the production of civil planes and helicopters, a senior aviation official said on Wednesday.

Alexander Dondukov, a chief designer at Yakovlev company, told Reuters that Aviatsionnaya Korporatsiya Yakovlev, the Tupolev company, Sukhoi military design bureau and the helicopter producer Mil had set up a "financial-industrial group" to carry out the project.
He did not say when the agreement was signed.
"We decided to join the technologies that each company possesses," Dondukov said, adding that the new alliance was intended to pull Russia's aviation industry out of deep crisis.
He said that Russia sold only four passenger aircraft in 1996 and that it had produced about 20 planes. "We will try to find a way out of this situation," he added.
Dondukov said the group had already elaborated a joint programme but he gave no details.
